STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_00599_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_00599_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_00599 (
    MonDReg,
    break_readreg,
    clk,
    dbrk_hit0_latch,
    dbrk_hit1_latch,
    dbrk_hit2_latch,
    dbrk_hit3_latch,
    debugack,
    monitor_error,
    monitor_ready,
    reset_n,
    resetlatch,
    tracemem_on,
    tracemem_trcdata,
    tracemem_tw,
    trc_im_addr,
    trc_on,
    trc_wrap,
    trigbrktype,
    trigger_state_1,

    jdo,
    jrst_n,
    st_ready_test_idle,
    take_action_break_a,
    take_action_break_b,
    take_action_break_c,
    take_action_ocimem_a,
    take_action_ocimem_b,
    take_action_tracectrl,
    take_no_action_break_a,
    take_no_action_break_b,
    take_no_action_break_c,
    take_no_action_ocimem_a
);

  output  [37:0] jdo;
  output         jrst_n;
  output         st_ready_test_idle;
  output         take_action_break_a;
  output         take_action_break_b;
  output         take_action_break_c;
  output         take_action_ocimem_a;
  output         take_action_ocimem_b;
  output         take_action_tracectrl;
  output         take_no_action_break_a;
  output         take_no_action_break_b;
  output         take_no_action_break_c;
  output         take_no_action_ocimem_a;
  input   [31:0] MonDReg;
  input   [31:0] break_readreg;
  input          clk;
  input          dbrk_hit0_latch;
  input          dbrk_hit1_latch;
  input          dbrk_hit2_latch;
  input          dbrk_hit3_latch;
  input          debugack;
  input          monitor_error;
  input          monitor_ready;
  input          reset_n;
  input          resetlatch;
  input          tracemem_on;
  input   [35:0] tracemem_trcdata;
  input          tracemem_tw;
  input   [6:0]  trc_im_addr;
  input          trc_on;
  input          trc_wrap;
  input          trigbrktype;
  input          trigger_state_1;

  wire    [37:0] sr;
  wire    [1:0]  vji_ir_in, vji_ir_out;

  // Internal variables
  wire vji_tck, vji_tdi, vji_sdr, vji_cdr, vji_rti, vji_uir, vji_udr;

  // Module functionalities
  wire jrst_n;
  assign jrst_n = (reset_n & !debugack);

  // Assign fixed values to the control signals
  assign vji_tck = 1'b0;
  assign vji_tdi = 1'b0;
  assign vji_sdr = 1'b0;
  assign vji_cdr = 1'b0;
  assign vji_rti = 1'b0;
  assign vji_uir = 1'b0;
  assign vji_udr = 1'b0;
  assign vji_ir_in = 2'b00;

  // Logic for take_action
  assign take_action_break_a     = dbrk_hit0_latch & !debugack;
  assign take_action_break_b     = dbrk_hit1_latch & !debugack;
  assign take_action_break_c     = dbrk_hit2_latch & !debugack;
  assign take_action_ocimem_a    = dbrk_hit3_latch & !debugack;
  assign take_action_ocimem_b    = tracemem_on & !debugack;
  assign take_action_tracectrl   = tracemem_tw & !debugack;

  assign take_no_action_break_a  = !dbrk_hit0_latch & !debugack;
  assign take_no_action_break_b  = !dbrk_hit1_latch & !debugack;
  assign take_no_action_break_c  = !dbrk_hit2_latch & !debugack;
  assign take_no_action_ocimem_a = !dbrk_hit3_latch & !debugack;

  // Logic for st_ready_test_idle
  assign st_ready_test_idle = monitor_ready & !monitor_error;

  // Logic for jdo
  assign jdo = {sr, vji_ir_out};

endmodule

Generate the module

InputThe generated Stage 1 specification plus the required top-module name rtlpp_00599.
InstructionImplement the complete synthesizable RTL module from the generated specification.

Protocol summary; the Stage 2 runner creates a fresh prompt.

OutputReconstructed complete RTL module.
Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.

Private final evaluation

Reference RTLClean RTL in the imported source record; hidden from Stage 2.
Score / oracleBinary formal equivalence to the hidden clean module

The formal oracle consumes the complete Stage 2 RTL file and compares it with the clean reference. A golden RTL file is scoring material, not a generated Stage 1 output.
